guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.intro:
§eSimple Byte Storage: Scripting§r adds two blocks:
- §bLogic Bus§r runs a JavaScript script and has its own §bidentifier§r.
- §bLogic Terminal§r edits the scripts of all Logic Buses in the network.

§eSteps§r
1. Connect the Terminal and the Buses to the network.
2. Put a Bus next to an inventory (chest, machine).
3. Right-click the Terminal, pick a Bus on the left, write the script, press §bSave§r, then §bRun§r.

§eIdentifiers§r
Right-click a Logic Bus to open ITS OWN GUI: type the ID of that very bus (letters, digits, _ - . up to 32) and press §bSet§r. The list shows all IDs in the network (xN = number of buses). Click an ID to copy it, Shift+click assigns it at once - handy to give many buses the same ID. The Logic Terminal shows the same list. A script can then reach the inventories next to ANY buses with that ID, not only its own. Several buses may share an ID: they act as one group.

Saving stops the bus: press Run to start it. §b-§r/§b+§r change the interval. Any error or exceeded limit stops the bus and shows the reason.

The top level runs once; §bfunction tick()§r is called every interval. Globals survive between runs (not a world reload).
guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.api.b:
Items are strings: §b"minecraft:iron_ingot"§r (NBT ignored).

§eNetwork§r
§bnet.count(id)§r, §bnet.has(id, n)§r
§bnet.list()§r - [{slot,id,count}]
§bnet.usedBytes()§r, §bnet.freeBytes()§r
§bnet.craft(id, n)§r - order autocrafting, returns accepted crafts

§eInventories§r
§bside("up")§r - neighbour of THIS bus (down/up/north/south/west/east) or null
§bside("up", "furnaces")§r - neighbours on that side of ALL buses with the ID "furnaces" as ONE endpoint (null if none)
§bbuses("furnaces")§r - how many buses have this ID
§bbusId§r - ID of this bus ("" if none)

endpoint methods:
§bslots()§r, §blist()§r, §bcount(id)§r
§bpull([id], [n])§r - inventory -> network
§bpush(id, [n])§r - network -> inventory
§bmove(other, [id], [n])§r - to another endpoint
They return the number of items moved. A group endpoint treats all its inventories as one.

§eOther§r
§blog(...)§r, §btime()§r

Standard JS works. Java is not accessible.

§eNetwork control§r
§bnet.available(id)§r, §bnet.reserved(id)§r, §bnet.energy()§r, §bnet.stats()§r
§bnet.canCraft(id,n)§r, §bnet.why(id,n)§r, §bnet.plan(id,n)§r
§bnet.queue()§r, §bnet.setPriority(id,p)§r, §bnet.pause(id)§r, §bnet.resume(id)§r, §bnet.cancel(id)§r
§bstock.list()§r, §bstock.set(id,min)§r, §bstock.clear(id)§r
§brecipes.block/unblock/prefer/unprefer(id)§r, §brecipes.skipUnpacking([bool])§r
§bjournal.write(text,[icon])§r, §bjournal.warn(...)§r, §bjournal.read([n])§r
§balert(text)§r - chat warning to owners of bound Wireless Terminals.
guide.simple_bytestorage_scripting.admin:
Config: §bconfig/simple_bytestorage_scripting-common.toml§r

§benabled§r - master switch
§bopsOnly§r - only operators (level 2+) and the singleplayer owner can save/run scripts and assign IDs
§ballowCrafting§r - allow net.craft
§bmaxScriptLength§r, §bminInterval§r
§bmaxInstructionsPerRun§r, §bmaxMillisPerRun§r
§bmaxItemsPerRun§r, §bmaxApiCallsPerRun§r

§eSandbox§r: no access to Java, files or network; limits on instructions, time, items and API calls per run. A script can only reach buses of its OWN network.

§6Note:§r there is no memory limit. On public servers enable §bopsOnly§r.
